{{Top|leg}}
The '''Lake Umberbool Shore Patrol''', also known as the '''Gungan Shore Patrol''', was an agency used by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] to patrol the area of [[Lake Umberbool]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. They were known to wear distinctive uniforms and were at times equipped with compact ''"farseein"''s in order to check upon distant targets. Typically, they were deployed during the [[Big Nasty Free-For-All]] competition, where they monitored the athletes that took part in it.

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Roos Tarpals/Legends|Roos Tarpals]] was present with the Shore Patrol and later borrowed a [[Kaadu/Legends|Kaadu]] from the [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the group in order to participate in the Big Nasty Free-For-All.
